issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Correct the boundary-face part of the face-sum estimate (the 1/2 is valid only on interior faces) and strengthen the sufficient condition on $\eta$ to $\eta>\max\{1,\mu_1^2\}\tilde C^2/\mu_0^2$ (or an equivalent corrected bound) in Lemma stability and the five later statements that quote the same threshold.
issues.overall_effect: The explicit sufficient penalty threshold stated in Lemma stability and repeated in Lemma added-1, Lemma added-2, Proposition added-1, Theorem added-2 and Theorem 4.2 is unjustified; for $\eta$ between $\tilde C^2\max\{1,\mu_1^2\}/(2\mu_0^2)$ and $\tilde C^2\max\{1,\mu_1^2\}/\mu_0^2$ the proofs of coercivity, uniform boundedness, strong convexity, existence/uniqueness and the error estimate fail as written.
issues.title: False face-sum inequality in the boundedness proof; the coercivity threshold on eta is unjustified
issues.why_classification: A routine constant-level correction plus doubling the sufficient penalty parameter repairs every affected proof with no new argument; all results, rates and guarantees survive in substance (only the explicit sufficient threshold changes).

diagnostic_evidence.quote: Moreover, if $\Eb \in \Hb_0(\curlb; \Omega) \cap \Hb^{s+1}(\Omega)$ for some number $s > 0$, then

issues.failure_explanation: Estimate \eqref{eqn:lemma4-3}, $\|E-\Pi_NE\|_{0,\Omega}\le C_Nh^{\min\{s,l\}+1}\|E\|_{s+1}$, requires $E\in H^{s+1}(\Omega)$, but Theorem 4.2 assumes only $E\in H^{s+1/2}(\Omega)$. Under the stated hypotheses the best available $L^2$ bound is $O(h^{\min\{s+1/2,l+1\}})$, so the linear term $(C_E+C_{E_h})\|E-E_I\|_{0,\Omega}$ in \eqref{eqn:error bound} is only of that order and the proof yields at best $\|E-E_h\|_h\le Ch^{\frac12\min\{\min\{s+1/2,l+1\},\,2\min\{s,l\}\}}$, strictly weaker than the claimed $h^{(\min\{s,l\}+1)/2}$ whenever $s<l+1/2$. In particular, for the advertised case $l=1$, $E\in H^{3/2}$ ($s=1$), the proof gives only $h^{3/4}$ instead of $h$.

issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Strengthen the regularity hypothesis of Theorem 4.2 to $E\in H_0(\curlb;\Omega)\cap H^{s+1}(\Omega)$ (with $\nabla\times E\in H^s$), so that \eqref{eqn:lemma4-3} is invoked within its hypotheses, and restate the low-regularity corollary with $E\in H^2$; the regime restriction $\min\{s,l\}\ge 1$ is handled separately.
issues.overall_effect: The main a priori error bound of Theorem 4.2, the unlabelled corollary $\|E-E_h\|_h\le Ch$ for $l=1$, $E\in H^{3/2}$, $\nabla\times E\in H^1$, and the abstract/intro claims of optimal convergence order, are not established for the advertised $H^{s+1/2}$-regularity class.
issues.title: Theorem 4.2 applies the L2 interpolation estimate outside its hypotheses (needs E in H^{s+1}, assumes H^{s+1/2})
issues.why_classification: The repair is a contained hypothesis change (half a derivative more regularity) with no new proof architecture and preserves the rate (e.g. $O(h)$ for linear elements with $E\in H^2$), but the advertised regularity scope, including the headline $H^{3/2}$ case, must be weakened, so it is more than minor.

diagnostic_evidence.quote:
Applying the error bounds \eqref{energy norm estimate} and \eqref{eqn:lemma4-3}, we derive from \eqref{eqn:error bound} that
\[
\|\Eb_I-\Eb_h\|_h\leq C\,h^{(\min\{s,l\}+1)/2}.  
\]

issues.failure_explanation: Even granting the $L^2$ bound used in the proof (i.e. after repairing the $H^{s+1}$ dependency of ISSUE-002), deriving $h^{(\min\{s,l\}+1)/2}$ from \eqref{eqn:error bound} requires the quadratic term $\frac{C_b^2}{\varepsilon}\|E_I-E\|_h^2=O(h^{2\min\{s,l\}})$ to be dominated by the linear term $O(h^{\min\{s,l\}+1})$, i.e. $2\min\{s,l\}\ge\min\{s,l\}+1$, i.e. $\min\{s,l\}\ge 1$. The theorem assumes only $s>1/2$ (with $l\ge1$, so $s\in(1/2,1)$ gives $\min\{s,l\}<1$); there the proof yields only $\|E-E_h\|_h\le Ch^{\min\{s,l\}}$, and the claimed faster rate is contradicted by the trivial lower bound $\|E-E_h\|_h\ge\inf_{v_h\in V_h}\|E-v_h\|_h\gtrsim h^{\min\{s,l\}}$ (e.g. for $\psi\equiv0$, $m=0$, which satisfies all assumptions and falls within the stated hypotheses), so the stated bound is false in that regime.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Add the condition $\min\{s,l\}\ge1$ (equivalently $s\ge1$ for $l\ge1$) to the hypotheses of Theorem 4.2, or restate the rate as $h^{\min\{s,l\}}$ in the regime $\min\{s,l\}\le1$.
issues.overall_effect: The error bound of Theorem 4.2 is unsupported and generally false for solutions with $s\in(1/2,1)$, a regime included in the theorem's stated scope $s>1/2$.
issues.title: Rate h^{(min{s,l}+1)/2} of Theorem 4.2 is underived and false in general for min{s,l} < 1
issues.why_classification: The stated rate is false in part of the advertised regime, so any repair must exclude or weaken that regime; the fix is local (a hypothesis or a piecewise rate statement) and leaves the comparable $s\ge1$ results intact — a limited weakening, not a major loss.
